description: No clean concept found. About a quarter of firing is at ply 3 (second player to move after three stones), for a specific, left-right asymmetric set of openings, mostly with an opponent stone in the bottom-left corner, on column 2's bottom cell, or stacked in column 5 (e.g. 5,5,5; 2,1,0; 0,1,2). The rest is scattered over midgame positions with no reliable cue; it never fires at ply 0-2.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changed move probabilities by at most 0.02 on 4 positions.
notes: Program = lookup of the 96 firing 3-move openings found by scanning all 343 with act (dev F1 0.409, P 1.0, R 0.26, sim share 0.06). Tried: last O on X on O vertical (F1 0.06); last stone in row 2 on my stone (adds recall, precision 0.12); column 2 nearly empty late game (F1 0.16); opponent threat in column 2 (F1 0.16). Midgame 75% of firing unexplained; strongly asymmetric, looks like a mixture or random direction. Synthesis best 7.03 < dev max 9.75.
